items.title: WAVLINK路由器命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经WireGuard CLI处理函数注入系统命令，以设备权限执行任意代码，完全控制设备。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商升级修复版本；无法升级时限制管理界面公网访问并关闭WireGuard CLI。
items.repro_note: 入口为WireGuard CLI处理函数，需确认管理面暴露及认证条件
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，公网暴露风险高
items.description: A vulnerability was found in WAVLINK WN553X1-B V260403_2.0.0. This vulnerability affects the function sub_419DA8 of the file /bin/ioos of the component WireGuard CLI Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument file_id results in os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: WAVLINK路由器命令注入漏洞
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用WN553X1-B的命令注入缺陷执行任意系统命令，导致设备被完全控制。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；临时限制WAN侧管理访问并关闭不必要的远程管理功能。
items.repro_note: 针对WN553X1-B管理面命令注入，需确认可访问入口与认证条件
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，公网暴露风险高
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in WAVLINK WN553X1-B V260403_2.0.0. This issue affects the function sub_41A748 of the file /bin/ioos of the component WireGuard CLI Group Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument group_id/group_name can lead to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: prefab-ui Deno权限过宽致RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证且能调用工具的客户端可利用Deno全局API与宽松权限执行任意代码，并读写文件、发起网络访问。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；限制工具调用权限并收紧Deno沙箱读写与网络权限。
items.repro_note: 需已认证且具备工具调用权限，利用Deno全局API与宽松权限执行代码
items.description: From prefab-ui 0.14.0 through 0.20.2 the launcher starts Deno with unrestricted --allow-read, --allow-write, and --allow-net, and the runner leaves the Deno API on the JavaScript global object. With authentication, any client allowed to call tools can.

items.title: WAVLINK路由器ovpn命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵ovpn_file的file_id参数注入系统命令，以设备权限执行任意命令并接管路由器。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；临时限制管理接口暴露，禁用或限制ovpn_file功能。
items.repro_note: 入口为ovpn_file处理逻辑，操纵file_id参数，需确认暴露与认证条件
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露管理面
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in WAVLINK WN553X1-B 260403_2.0.0. This affects the function sub_4162A8 of the file /bin/ioos of the component ovpn_file Handler. Such manipulation of the argument file_id leads to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
